tech_stack.persistence_access: Spring Data R2DBC + Flyway (embedded H2 for boot/test only)

topology: modular monolith, hexagonal per module; one deployable, one composition root

modules.name: orchestration
modules.depth: core: richest model (ChatSession, Turn, ToolCall, TokenStream)

modules.name: shared
modules.depth: minimal shared kernel: published events (TurnCompleted, ToolCalled, TurnLimitReached, SummaryUpdated), correlation filter, config

layers.name: domain
layers.rule: pure Java; owns invariants; no framework annotations

layers.name: application
layers.rule: use cases behind inbound ports; outbound ports (repositories, LlmGateway, ToolGateway, ContextWindowQuery, HistoryQuery, AuditTrail); no framework types

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.rule: R2DBC adapters, Spring AI adapters (anticorruption layer), in-process event adapters, config

layers.name: interface
layers.rule: WebFlux controllers (SSE), event consumers; imports application only; never exposes domain objects

layers.name: composition-root
layers.rule: single @SpringBootApplication in base package com.blackboard.conversationalagent; wiring configuration units

integration: Orchestration -> Memory: async event TurnCompleted (customer-supplier); Memory -> Orchestration: synchronous ContextWindowQuery port read at turn start
Orchestration -> History: async events TurnCompleted and ToolCalled (conformist, History only appends); History -> Orchestration: synchronous HistoryQuery port read after ownership check
external LLM provider and Spring AI backend tools -> Orchestration and Memory: anticorruption layer in infrastructure adapters; no provider types leak inward
events are in-process, at-least-once, delivered over non-blocking Reactor sinks (onBackpressureBuffer(capacity,false)); reads are direct query ports, never event machinery

build_order: T0 scaffold (pom, wrapper, single composition root, test-profile activation, surefire timeout, Flyway runner + embedded H2 substitute)
shared: published events, correlation WebFilter, audit port
history: domain -> application ports -> infrastructure (migration, R2DBC adapter) -> consumers and query
memory: domain -> application ports -> infrastructure (migration, R2DBC adapter, LLM summarizer ACL) -> TurnCompleted consumer and query
orchestration: domain -> application (turn loop, limits) -> infrastructure (R2DBC session store, Spring AI LLM/tool ACL, event publishers) -> interface (SSE controller)
composition-root wiring configuration, observability config, integration slice with WebTestClient

rules.statement: Every chat session belongs to a specific user and tenant; nobody can read or send messages into someone else's conversation (403 Forbidden)
A turn makes at most 5 tool calls and lasts at most 30 seconds; on hitting either limit it stops cleanly and informs the user
Streaming and LLM waits never block Netty event-loop threads
Cap of 5 tool calls and 30-second timeout per message, stopping cleanly and telling the user
Token Stream: The live SSE feed sending text chunks and status updates back to the client.
The Context Window holds the last 12 messages in full detail and older messages only as a running summary, never exceeding the 16,000-token limit
Context Window: The recent messages (last 12 in full detail) plus a rolling summary sent to the model on each turn, within the 16,000-token limit.
History entries are append-only and each carries token counts

surfaces.name: create chat session HTTP inbound
operations: create a Chat Session owned by the calling user and tenant
surfaces.traced_from: Chat Session & Turn Orchestration.in_scope: Session ownership by user and tenant

surfaces.name: send message SSE HTTP inbound
operations: run a Turn and stream the Token Stream over SSE (text chunks and tool status updates)
403 Forbidden for a session of another user or tenant
stop cleanly and inform the user at 5 tool calls or 30 seconds
surfaces.traced_from: Chat Session & Turn Orchestration.in_scope: Turn execution, Status updates, SSE streaming of tokens

surfaces.name: reload chat history HTTP inbound
operations: reload past chat entries after ownership check (403 otherwise); delegates to the History query port
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Chat History Log -> Orchestration reload of past chats

surfaces.name: context window query internal call
operations: return the read-only current Context Window (last 12 messages + rolling summary, 16,000-token limit) for a session
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Conversation Memory -> Orchestration synchronous query

surfaces.name: turn completed memory consumer
operations: consume TurnCompleted, update rolling summary idempotently by session id + turn id, publish SummaryUpdated

surfaces.name: turn completed history consumer
operations: consume TurnCompleted, append user message and assistant reply entries with token counts

surfaces.name: tool called history consumer
operations: consume ToolCalled, append tool call entry with token counts

surfaces.name: history reload query internal call
operations: return read-only history entries of a session in keyset order; ownership already verified by Orchestration
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Chat History Log -> Orchestration synchronous query

assumptions.statement: RESOLVED idempotency: delivery is at-least-once; the dedup discriminator is the natural identity (session id + turn id + entry sequence within the turn). The mutable message payload is excluded from identity. Outcome per resend class: same identity = repeat, no-op (no second row, even when payload differs); new identity = new fact, appended. A client retry of POST message with a new turn id is a new turn. Invariant owner: Chat History Log (unique constraint plus append-only domain rule).

RESOLVED TurnLimitReached: Candidate B. The user-visible notice travels in the Token Stream and in the final assistant reply carried by TurnCompleted; TurnLimitReached is internal, observability-only (metric and step log), with no subscriber and no history schema of its own.

RESOLVED SummaryUpdated: Candidate B. No subscriber; serialization is internal to Memory: the Context Window query for a session waits until the pending TurnCompleted for that session is applied, bounded by the remaining 30-second turn timeout, after which the last committed summary is served (last 12 messages stay fresh). SummaryUpdated is observability-only.
Tenant/role model, message size, summary length and history retention are unspecified and left unbounded; no values invented.
No Spring AI version, LLM provider or authentication scheme is named by the description; the user and tenant identity of the caller arrives as a trusted principal resolved by the security phase.

risks: Staleness posture (map): next turn of the same session is serialized behind the previous TurnCompleted application in Memory; summary freshness may lag only beyond the 30-second budget
History reload is eventual: a just-finished turn may be briefly missing
Event/query loop Orchestration <-> Memory is deliberate; no shared model
Blocking LLM or R2DBC calls on Netty event-loop threads would violate the non-blocking rule; all adapters reactive
Duplicate history rows under retried delivery unless A1 identity is enforced by a unique key
Unbounded quantities (A4) risk model-context overflow on very large single messages; 16,000-token limit enforced by Memory
Timeouts and caps (5 tool calls, 30 seconds, 12 messages, 16,000 tokens) must be bound to config keys, not hardcoded
Tool calls with side effects are not undone when a turn is cut at a limit

drivers: append-only audit and history of every user message, tool call and assistant reply
reload of past chats and usage tracking via token counts
session ownership checks must be strongly consistent

storage_paradigm.primary: relational (one logical store, one table group per context, no cross-context joins)
rejected: log/stream store (adds an engine without measured need)
storage_paradigm.change_conditions: measured history volume exceeding relational capacity

data_model.invariants: belongs to exactly one user and tenant; immutable ownership
data_model.sensitivity: identifiers; personal data classification by security phase

data_model.key: turn id; session id by reference
data_model.invariants: at most 5 tool calls and 30 seconds
context window never exceeds 16,000 tokens; last 12 messages in full
only the last 12 held in full detail

data_model.key: session id + turn id + entry sequence (natural identity, unique)
data_model.invariants: append-only, never updated or deleted; each carries token counts

queries: session by id and owner/tenant (strong, per request)
context window of session: last 12 messages + summary (strong per session, bounded)
history of session in keyset order by turn id and sequence, bounded page size (bounded staleness)
persistence.migration_plan: Flyway, ordered, expand-only V<n>__snake_case.sql scripts under src/main/resources/db/migration, runner configured in src/main/resources/application.yml with spring.flyway.locations classpath:db/migration; distinct JDBC and R2DBC URL placeholders; rollback by forward-fix; embedded H2 only under the test profile
persistence.backup_recovery: operator-owned periodic backup of the primary store with restore test; history is the only irrecoverable concept; sessions and summaries are rebuildable from history in part
open_questions: history retention and archive policy unspecified
tenant model and message size bounds unspecified

uncounted_steps.reason: counted through chat.access.denied on refusal; the permitted path is covered by chat.turn.completed
read-only query served inside the turn, timed by chat.turn.duration
benign no-op under at-least-once delivery; recorded as a step log only

export.sink: local append-only rolling JSON-lines log file (logs/conversational-agent.log) shipped by an external collector; metrics via actuator only, no push or scrape target named; no hard runtime dependency on any external tool, boot test passes with it absent
export.log_correlation: micrometer context-propagation with Hooks.enableAutomaticContextPropagation(); correlationId also a field of each audit record
